name: Data Governance Policy
description: Rules for data classification and PIT handling

pit_classifications.STRICT_PIT: Data available at decision time with no revision
pit_classifications.PIT_WITH_KNOWN_LAG: Data available with known publication delay
pit_classifications.REVISED_HISTORY: Data subject to revision; original vintage unavailable
pit_classifications.NON_PIT_RESEARCH_ONLY: Data not PIT; research use only

rules: Every dataset must declare PIT classification
Unknown PIT status must not silently pass as valid
REVISED_HISTORY cannot receive same evidential status as STRICT_PIT
Vintage data required for confirmatory deployment claims
PIT classification determines allowed conclusion strength

conclusion_strength_by_pit.PIT_WITH_KNOWN_LAG: Full evidential status with lag documented
